## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what changes. Link the Issue or accepted specification.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm verify:repository`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test` and `pnpm test:node`
- [ ] After commit: `pnpm verify:pack-exports`
- [ ] User-facing docs updated in English and Chinese, when applicable

For host/browser changes, record the exact DSH host, actual page verification and evidence link. Maintainer test artifacts belong in `a2d2-dev/project`, not the source tree. Explain checks that do not apply or could not run.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility limits, migration concerns and third-party code or licenses, if applicable. Remove credentials and private user/project data from all examples, screenshots and logs.
